od.title: Someone is overdosing
od.s1: Call 911. Say someone is not breathing.
od.s2: Try to wake them. Shout their name. Rub the middle of their chest hard.
od.s3: If you have Narcan, spray it into one nostril.
od.s4: If they are not breathing, give one breath every 5 seconds if you know how.
od.s5: No change after 2 to 3 minutes? Give a second dose in the other nostril.
od.s6: Lay them on their side. Stay with them until help comes.
od.review_note: These steps follow national public health guidance.

about.title: About this app
about.p1: This app lists free help from the City of Detroit and community groups. Info can change. If it's an emergency, call 911.
about.p2: We don't collect your name, number, or location. There are no accounts. What you tap stays on this phone.
about.sig_ok: This list is signed, and the signature checked out.
about.sig_dev: Test build: this list is signed with a test key.
about.open: The code and the list are open for anyone to check or reuse.

about.credits_city: City of Detroit open data, for parks, streets, recreation centers, harm reduction stations and the neighborhood pages.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.sub: What this app keeps, and what it sends
privacy.lede: This app never asks who you are. Here is everything it keeps and everything it sends.
privacy.phone_1: The list of places, so the app works without internet.
privacy.phone_2: Places you save. You can clear them any time.
privacy.phone_4: A random key made on this phone. It is never sent.
privacy.phone_5: Reports waiting for a signal. They go out when you are back online.
privacy.where: If you tap "Use my location" or type a ZIP code, it is used on this phone to sort places by distance. It is never saved or sent.
privacy.sent_h: Sent only when you tap Send
privacy.sent_1: When you report a place (for example, "closed") or add a place: which place, what kind of report, your note if you wrote one, and the time. Phone numbers and emails in notes are removed before anything is kept.
privacy.sent_2: A code for that place and that day, made from your random key, so one phone counts once. It changes every day and for every place, so no one can link your reports to each other or to you.
privacy.never: No name, phone number, email, account, ads, or tracking. We never keep your internet address.
privacy.reset: Make a new random key. Reports you send after this can't be matched to ones you sent before, even on the same day.
privacy.reset_done: Done. This phone has a new key.

report.queued: Thanks. We'll send this when you're back online.
report.sent_place: Thanks. We can't promise when it gets fixed. If someone is hurt or in danger, call 911.

link.jobs.mrs.body: Michigan Rehabilitation Services helps people with disabilities get ready for, find, and keep a job.
link.jobs.mrs.label: Apply to MRS
link.jobs.veterans.title: Job help for veterans
link.jobs.veterans.body: Veterans and eligible spouses are served first at Michigan Works! offices. Tell the staff you are a veteran.
link.jobs.veterans.label: Read more
link.training.daw_training.title: Training paid for by Detroit at Work
link.training.daw_training.body: Training in health care, computers, trucking, building trades, and factory work for Detroiters who qualify. Programs change, so call first.
link.training.daw_training.label: See training
link.training.youthbuild.title: YouthBuild: paid building-trades training
link.training.youthbuild.body: Paid construction training with GED help for young adults. Ages and cities differ by program; check the page.
link.training.youthbuild.label: Read about YouthBuild
link.training.trade_connect.title: A path into the Carpenters union
link.training.trade_connect.body: Job readiness, a 4-week pre-apprenticeship, then a paid 4-month apprenticeship with the Carpenters union.
link.training.trade_connect.label: Fill out the interest form
link.training.fast_track.title: Construction jobs on City projects
link.training.fast_track.body: Construction Fast Track connects Detroiters to construction jobs on City projects.
link.training.fast_track.label: Read about Fast Track
link.training.plumbers.title: Plumbers apprenticeship: applications open
link.training.plumbers.body: A paid 5-year plumbing apprenticeship. Applications close December 18, 2026, or when 200 people apply.
link.training.plumbers.label: See how to apply
link.training.older_workers.title: Paid job training for people 55 and older
link.training.older_workers.body: The Urban League's paid job training for people 55 and older with low income in Wayne or Oakland County.
link.training.older_workers.label: Read more
link.record.after_prison.title: Job help after state prison
link.record.after_prison.body: Detroit at Work's training, paid internships, and bus help for people home from state prison in the last 5 months.
link.record.after_prison.label: Read more
link.record.project_clean_slate.title: Free record clearing for Detroiters
link.record.project_clean_slate.body: Project Clean Slate gives free legal help to Detroit residents who want old convictions cleared.
link.record.project_clean_slate.label: Register with Project Clean Slate
link.record.clean_slate.title: Which old convictions clear on their own
link.record.clean_slate.body: Michigan's Clean Slate law: which convictions clear by themselves, when, and the limits.
link.record.clean_slate.label: Read about Clean Slate
link.school.daw_ged.title: Free GED classes through Detroit at Work
link.school.daw_ged.body: Free classes with the Detroit schools and others, in person or online, day or evening.
link.school.daw_ged.label: Sign up for classes
link.school.dpscd.title: Adult classes with the Detroit schools
link.school.dpscd.body: Free adult classes for the GED, a high school diploma, reading, math, and English.
link.school.dpscd.label: Sign up with DPSCD
link.school.adult_ed_map.title: Find adult classes near you
link.school.adult_ed_map.body: The State of Michigan's map of adult education classes.
link.school.adult_ed_map.label: Open the map
link.school.hse.title: GED and HiSET tests
link.school.hse.body: Michigan accepts the GED and the HiSET. The page lists the test fees and a voucher that may pay for one try per subject while funding lasts.
link.school.hse.label: See test costs
link.school.reconnect.title: Free community college at 21 and older
link.school.reconnect.body: Michigan Reconnect pays tuition at your local community college if you are 21 or older, have lived in Michigan a year, have a diploma or GED, and no college degree.
link.school.reconnect.label: Read about Reconnect
link.school.achievement.title: College money for recent graduates
link.school.achievement.body: The Michigan Achievement Scholarship, for people who finished high school or a GED in 2023 or later.
link.school.achievement.label: Read more
link.clothes.goodfellows.title: Holiday box for kids 4 to 13
link.clothes.goodfellows.body: Warm clothes, toys, and books for kids 4 to 13 in Detroit, Highland Park, Hamtramck, and some nearby cities (not Dearborn). Apply online by October 31, 2026.
link.clothes.goodfellows.label: Apply to Goodfellows
link.baby.diaper_bank.title: Diapers each month for babies under 3
link.baby.diaper_bank.body: For children under 3 in Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb counties. Fill out the online form each month and pick a pickup place.
link.baby.diaper_bank.label: Ask for diapers
link.phone.lifeline.title: Money off your phone bill (Lifeline)
link.phone.lifeline.body: If you get SNAP, Medicaid, SSI or similar help, or have low income, you may get money off your phone or internet bill each month. You apply through a phone company that takes Lifeline.
link.phone.lifeline.label: Learn about Lifeline
link.phone.lifeline_providers.title: Phone companies that take Lifeline
link.phone.lifeline_providers.body: The State's list of home phone and cell phone companies that take Lifeline.
link.phone.lifeline_providers.label: See the list
link.phone.library_laptops.title: Borrow a laptop or hotspot
link.phone.library_laptops.body: Detroit and Highland Park residents can borrow a laptop, Chromebook, or Wi-Fi hotspot with an adult library card.
link.phone.library_laptops.label: Borrow from the library
link.phone.tech_hubs.title: Places to use a computer in Detroit
link.phone.tech_hubs.body: Neighborhood places in Detroit where you can use a computer, get online, and get help learning.
link.phone.tech_hubs.label: See the tech hub list
link.phone.digital_skills.title: Free computer classes and a free device
link.phone.digital_skills.body: Digital Skills Detroit classes for Detroit residents. Finish 15 hours of training and you can get a free device.
link.phone.digital_skills.label: Find a class
link.phone.eii.title: Neighborhood internet: North End, Highland Park, Hamtramck
link.phone.eii.body: Community-run home internet for Detroit's North End, Highland Park, and Hamtramck.
link.phone.eii.label: Sign up for home internet
link.phone.att_access.title: Lower-cost home internet from AT&T
link.phone.att_access.body: Lower-cost AT&T home internet if you get SNAP, SSI, WIC, or school meals, or your income is low. The price and speed depend on your address.
link.phone.att_access.label: See Access from AT&T
link.childcare.cdc.title: Help paying for child care
link.childcare.cdc.body: The State helps pay for child care while you work, go to school, or get training. Apply on MI Bridges or at your MDHHS office.
link.childcare.cdc.label: Learn about child care help
link.childcare.findprek.title: Free PreK for 4-year-olds
link.childcare.findprek.body: Free state PreK (GSRP) for 4-year-olds in Wayne County. Choose your top three places and apply online, or text for help.
link.childcare.findprek.label: Apply for free PreK
link.childcare.great_start.title: Find child care and free preschool
link.childcare.great_start.body: Search for licensed child care, free PreK, and Head Start near you.
link.childcare.great_start.label: Search for child care
link.childcare.starfish.title: Starfish Head Start and Early Head Start
link.childcare.starfish.body: Free early learning for babies to preschoolers at Starfish centers, many in Detroit, for families whose income qualifies. Fill out an interest form and they will call you.
link.childcare.starfish.label: Contact Starfish
link.rides.medicaid_rides.title: Free rides to the doctor with Medicaid
link.rides.medicaid_rides.body: If you have Medicaid, your health plan gives free rides to covered care. Call the ride number on your plan card; most need 2 to 3 days' notice.
link.rides.medicaid_rides.label: See ride phone numbers
link.rides.ddot_reduced.title: 50-cent DDOT bus fare
link.rides.ddot_reduced.body: Pay 50 cents a ride if you are 65 or older, have a disability, have Medicare, or are a student. Apply for a Reduced Fare ID.
link.rides.ddot_reduced.label: Get a DDOT Reduced Fare ID
link.rides.ride_to_rise.title: Free DDOT rides for Detroit students
link.rides.ride_to_rise.body: Kids in grades K to 12 who go to school in Detroit ride DDOT buses free. Show your school ID.
link.rides.ride_to_rise.label: Learn about Ride to Rise
link.rides.paratransit.title: DDOT door-to-door rides for people with disabilities
link.rides.paratransit.body: Shared door-to-door rides for people whose disability keeps them from riding the bus. Apply first; each ride is $2.50, cash only. Same-day rides are possible.
link.rides.paratransit.label: Learn about DDOT Paratransit
link.rides.smart_reduced.title: SMART bus: 50-cent fare, students free
link.rides.smart_reduced.body: Pay 50 cents a ride on SMART if you are 65 or older or have a disability. Students with a school ID ride free.
link.rides.smart_reduced.label: See SMART reduced fares
link.rides.dearborn_seniors.title: Dearborn rides for people 60 and older
link.rides.dearborn_seniors.body: Rides anywhere in Dearborn, including to the doctor, for residents 60 and older. $2 round trip; call at least 4 days ahead.
link.rides.dearborn_seniors.label: Learn about senior rides
link.pets.grace.title: Free spay and neuter for Detroit dogs
link.pets.grace.body: Free spay or neuter, shots, and a microchip for dogs that live in Detroit. No income or breed limits.
link.pets.grace.label: Get a Project GRACE voucher
link.pets.spay_van.title: Spay and neuter van from Detroit
link.pets.spay_van.body: Drop your pet at a Detroit stop at 7 am. Your pet is fixed at the clinic in Warren and comes back the next morning.
link.pets.spay_van.label: Book the van
link.dental.healthy_kids_dental.title: Medicaid dental care for kids
link.dental.healthy_kids_dental.body: Medicaid covers dental care for children and teens through Healthy Kids Dental.
link.dental.healthy_kids_dental.label: Learn about Healthy Kids Dental
tile.day: A place to be during the day
results.none_links: We don't list any places for this yet. These programs can help:
link.beds.safebeds.title: Find an open shelter bed (313SafeBeds)
link.beds.safebeds.body: A Detroit tool for finding shelter beds in Wayne, Oakland and Macomb counties. Answer three questions and it gives you phone numbers to call. The shelter decides who comes in. It is their site, not ours.
link.beds.safebeds.label: Open 313SafeBeds
about.p3: Each listing says where it came from and when someone last checked it. If nobody has checked it, we say so.
